reader.requirement: At --std 85 every WHEN phrase (each set of selection objects, so each of several consecutive WHEN phrases sharing one imperative statement separately) must carry exactly as many selection objects (ANY, TRUE, FALSE, condition, identifier/literal/arithmetic expression, THRU range each counting one) as the EVALUATE has selection subjects; a phrase with more or fewer is a compile-time refusal. WHEN OTHER carries no set and is not counted. The witness covers only the legal half.
